      public Qualifiers(Domain d, Qualifiers aq, AnnotationMirror anyQualifier, AnnotationMirror defaultQualifier)
      Creates a new Qualifiers.
      Parameters:
      d - a Domain; may be null if both anyQualifier and defaultQualifier are non-null
      aq - a non-null Qualifiers
      anyQualifier - a (possibly null) AnnotationMirror representing the any qualifier; if null, then d must be non-null
      defaultQualifier - a (possibly null) AnnotationMirror representing the default qualifier; if null, then d must be non-null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if aq is null or if d is null in certain situations
      See Also:
